title: Perelman's unspoken unified theory

tellings.quote: And like he I think he claims that he has a unified theory and he just won't talk.

plain: Grigori Perelman, the reclusive Russian mathematician who lives in Siberia, has a unified theory of physics and simply refuses to talk about it. Michels says this himself, hedging it with "I think he claims," and gives no source. If true, one of the great open problems of science could already be solved and kept hidden in one man's head.
